name: Terguride
summary: Terguride, sold under the brand name Teluron, is a serotonin receptor antagonist and dopamine receptor agonist of the ergoline family. It is approved for and used as a prolactin inhibitor in the treatment of hyperprolactinemia (high prolactin levels) in Japan. Terguride is taken by mouth.

pharmacology.text: Terguride acts as an agonist of the dopamine D2 receptor and as an antagonist of the serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B receptors, among other actions. As an antagonist of the 5-HT2B receptor, terguride is not associated with cardiac valvulopathy.

uses.text: Terguride (INN, JAN), sold under the brand name Teluron, is a serotonin receptor antagonist and dopamine receptor agonist of the ergoline family. It is approved for and used as a prolactin inhibitor in the treatment of hyperprolactinemia (high prolactin levels) in Japan. Terguride is taken by mouth.

summaryZh: 特麥角脲（英語：Terguride，商品名：Teluron）是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C20H28N4O，屬於麥角靈衍生物，是5-羥色胺受體拮抗劑和多巴胺受體激動劑。
summaryZhHans: 特麦角脲（英语：Terguride，商品名：Teluron）是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C20H28N4O，属于麦角灵衍生物，是5-羟色胺受体拮抗剂和多巴胺受体激动剂。

sideEffects.en: Like other dopamine agonists, it can cause nausea, dizziness, headache and low blood pressure on standing.
sideEffects.zh: 與其他多巴胺促效劑一樣，它可能造成噁心、頭暈、頭痛與起身時血壓過低。
sideEffects.zhHans: 与其他多巴胺促效剂一样，它可能造成恶心、头晕、头痛与起身时血压过低。

fact.en: It is a close relative of the ergot drug lisuride with one double bond removed. Ergolines like it trace back to ergot, a fungus that infects rye and other grains.
fact.zh: 特麥角脲是麥角類藥物麥角乙脲的近親，只是少了一個雙鍵。這類麥角靈化合物都源自麥角，一種會感染黑麥等穀物的真菌。
fact.zhHans: 特麦角脲是麦角类药物麦角乙脲的近亲，只是少了一个双键。这类麦角灵化合物都源自麦角，一种会感染黑麦等谷物的真菌。
